answer: A proposal is valid only if 50% of a randomly sampled horizon panel attests it in each of 4 consecutive rounds. To control the outcome an attacker needs 50% of every draw — owning 25 identities across a pool of pulse registrants means the odds stay low and the cost stays at 50000 POA. The beacon registrar re-randomizes panels per round and publishes draw logs, forcing a farm to bribe or mint a majority, not a handful.
